realWorldScenario: Linear scan O(n) — linked lists don't support random access, so binary search is not possible.

title: Java LinkedList Class
question: What does Java's built-in LinkedList class provide? Is it a singly or doubly linked list?
realWorldScenario: java.util.LinkedList is doubly linked and implements both List and Deque — you can use it as a list, stack, or queue.

title: Array vs Linked List Trade-offs
